name: tension_bar
source: σ=F/A, δ=FL/EA — patch-test property: interior stress must be uniform
notes: Box x∈[-30,30], y∈[-6,6], z∈[0,12]. Interior stress/strain is exact. Absolute tip displacement runs ~5% low at pitch 2: the clamped face kills ~1.5 element layers of strain and nodal-force spreading under-excites the loaded-face layer (consistent-load boundary effect). disp_diff measures the clean interior gradient and is the accurate probe; the deficit shrinks with pitch.
